title: Understanding the Sampling Frame
text: Think about who the TAs are likely to encounter in the discussion sections. Are these students representative of the entire population of interest?

title: Defining the Population of Interest
text: Consider what it means for a student to be an 'above-average spender' on chocolate milk. How might this affect who should be included in the survey?

title: Evaluating the Sampling Method
text: What is the likelihood that every fifth student in a discussion section is an above-average spender on chocolate milk?

title: Sampling Frame vs. Population
text: The sampling frame is the list of individuals from which the sample is drawn. Is this list the same as the population of interest?
